current_backend.gap_summary: Backend has 25+ post engines + ~16 dispatcher actions but NO browser-facing product surface, NO upload-pipe, NO controller-agnostic Master Post unified API, NO billing/tier-gate, NO neutral input parser (Fusion .nc / Mastercam NCI / hyperMILL .H / Esprit / InventorHSM). Master Post is internal infra, not productized.

new_units.title: MasterPost unified API surface
new_units.spec: POST /api/masterpost/generate {neutral_toolpath, controller_id, options} → {gcode, warnings, telemetry}. Wraps MasterPostProcessorUnifiedAGIEngine + dialect routers (Lathe/WEDM/Mill).
new_units.acceptance: 200 OK on 5 controllers × 3 toolpath fixtures; <500ms p95; round-trip via prism_cam:post_process dispatcher

new_units.title: MasterPost upload pipe + ingest
new_units.spec: Browser file upload (drag-drop) → S3/local-blob → MIME sniff → route to per-format parser. Supports .nc/.mcam/.nci/.h/.cnc/.tap up to 50MB.
new_units.acceptance: Upload 10 sample files; correct format detection ≥95%; presigned URL flow tested

new_units.title: Neutral toolpath schema (NTS)
new_units.spec: Canonical intermediate representation: moves (G0/G1/G2/G3 + axes), tool-changes, coolant, spindle, M-codes, WCS, cycles. Used as bridge between any parser and any emitter.
new_units.acceptance: schemaVersion 1.0.0; round-trip Fusion .nc → NTS → Fanuc emit matches reference within 1% line-diff

new_units.title: Fusion 360 .nc parser → NTS
new_units.spec: Parse Autodesk Fusion 360 CAM `.nc` neutral output into NTS. Most common CAM source for SMB.
new_units.acceptance: 5 JM Die Fusion exports parse without warnings; tool-table preserved

new_units.title: Mastercam NCI/MCAM parser → NTS
new_units.spec: Parse Mastercam intermediate (NCI) and project (MCAM) into NTS. Reuse MastercamControllerCatalogEngine.
new_units.acceptance: 3 Mastercam exports parse; controller hint extracted

new_units.title: hyperMILL .H parser → NTS
new_units.spec: Parse hyperMILL Heidenhain-format intermediate.
new_units.acceptance: 2 hyperMILL exports parse; toolpath kinematics preserved

new_units.title: InventorHSM/HSMWorks parser → NTS
new_units.spec: Wrap InventorCAMCodeGeneratorEngine (E0202) for inbound NTS.
new_units.acceptance: 3 HSM exports parse

new_units.title: Esprit/SolidCAM parser → NTS
new_units.spec: Tier-2 CAM bridge for high-end shops.
new_units.acceptance: 2 fixtures parse

summary.verdict: PRODUCT-SHAPED FROM RICH BACKEND — Master Post backend is 70% complete (25+ engines, 16 dispatcher actions, 5 controller families wired). What's missing is the productization layer: unified API + upload pipe + neutral toolpath schema + 8 emitter polish + UI + billing. P0 path (18 units) ships in 4 weeks targeting Fanuc/Haas/Okuma — the JM Die controller set — as launch beachhead. Revenue model: $0 free (5 posts/mo + watermark) → $49/mo Pro (100 posts) → $199/mo Shop (unlimited + API).
summary.one_line: 40 units / 18 P0 / 4-week MVP launching Fanuc+Haas+Okuma (JM Die set) with per-program metered billing — backend is 70% ready, only product surface + emitter polish + billing are net-new.
